tei:div.tei:p: "$ (369)༄༅// dpal 'bri gung pa'i dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rtsa ba lhan thabs dang bcas pa'i gzhung chings khog dbub dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

(370)༄༅// na mo ratna gu ru bhyaḥ dri med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// ma 'dres shes bya'i dngos po ji lta bar// thams cad gzigs pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje// mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba mchog gi zhal nas gsungs pa yi// dam chos khyad 'phags thun mong ma yin pa// mngon du mdzad pa'i bzhed lugs dpag med kyang*// rmongs pas dran pa cung zad tsam zhig bri// spyir de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi dbang phyug yin// des sde snod dang rgyud sde sgrub thabs la sogs pa mang po dpag tu med pa gsungs pas go lugs rtogs lugs so sor byung zhing thams cad kyang zab cing ngo mtshar che ba 'ba' zhig yin no// de la 'dir ni rang gzhan gyi bzhed pa'i khyad par bag tsam mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig snang bas/ de rnams legs par phyed pa yin no// 'di ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gcig pa zhes bya ba khyad par gyi gnad brgya lnga bcu yod pa las/ de yang tshoms bdun gyis gcod kyi dmigs 'byed pa dang po ni 'di yin te/ 1 spyir de bzhin gshegs (371)pa ni chos kyi dbang phyug yin pas des gang ltar bzhed pa de ltar gsungs pas de nyid du 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas kyis chos thams cad gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs kho na bstan par bzhed do/ 2 /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pas de dag gi 'jug sgo yang gang rung ba la zhugs pas kyang byang chub chen po thob par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gcig tu bzhed do/ 3 /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi gdul bya gang mos pa'i lam du 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la ma skye ba'i rim par bzhed do/ 4 /chos kyi 'khor lo gsum yang rigs can tha dad pa la gsungs pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni chos kyi 'khor lo gsum 'khor gyi rtogs pa'i khyad par bstan par bzhed do/ 5 /chos kyi 'khor lo gsum po brjod bya tha dad pas so sor ma 'dres par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kyi 'khor lo re re la yang gsum ka tshang bar bzhed do// (372) / 6 chos kyi 'khor lo de dag gi don 'brel de ltar gnas kyang tshig gis mtshan pa mi gsal bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma phyi ma'i sa byon snga ma snga ma la gnas par bzhed do/ 7 /'khor lo gsum ni gnas dang dus la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis 'byed par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mdo dang don gyi gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du nges par bzhed do/ 8 /bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo ni mngon pa yin te/ 'dul ba'i sde snod ma yin par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'dul ba'i sde snod ni bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lor bzhed do/ 9 /theg pa sna tshogs ston pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo bar pa yin la// mtshan nyid med pa ni nges don du ston pa mang mod kyi// 'dir ni theg pa sna tshogs ston pa nyid nges don chos kyi 'khor lor bzhed do/ 10 /bka' thams cad drang ba'i don dang nges pa'i don la sogs par bstan pas 'ga' zhig de bzhin gshegs pas thabs kyis brdzun par gsungs par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mtha' drug du gsungs pa thams cad kyang nges don 'ba' zhig du bzhed do/ 11 /dbu ma'i bka' dang sems tsam pa'i bka' tha dad par 'dod de/ ༈ /rdo rje'i gsung*/ sems tsam ston pa'i bka' nyid dbu ma ston par bzhed/ 12 /log pa'i kun rdzob kyis don byed mi nus pa 'dod de/ ༈ /rdo rje'i gsung*/ log pa'i kun rdzob kyis kyang don byed nus par bzhed do/ 13 /mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lam ni sa bcus bgrod la gcig char 'jug pa rnams la de ltar ma yin par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni lam thams cad sa cu'i bcus bgrod par bzhed do/ 14 /rim gyis 'jug pa dang gcig char 'jug pa gnyis su 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni lam thams cad rim gyis 'jug par bzhed do/ 15 /sgrib pa thams cad ni thog mar las kyi sgrib pa de nas nyon mongs (373)pa'i sgrib pa dang mthar shes bya'i sgrib pa spong bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la sdong ba yang yod par bzhed do/ 16 /tshad ma na mu stegs kyi rig byed dang thun mong gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi chos su mi 'gyur bar 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni tshad ma sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes su bzhed do/ 17 /tshad ma ni grub mtha' ngan pa sun 'don pa nyid yin pa las tshad ma'i 'bras bu med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni tshad ma'i 'bras bu chos nyid stong pa nyid ston par bzhed do/ 18 /grub mtha' sna tshogs sun 'don par byed pa rgya gar gyi mu stegs la sogs pa la dgos par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud par bzhed do/ 19 /mu stegs kyi lta spyod sgrub pa thams cad spang bya 'ba' zhig tu 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni mu stegs pa la yang gshis kyi dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang po yod par bzhed do/ 20 /phyi rol mu stegs pa dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad par chos rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi la sogs pa khyad par sna tshogs su 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs su 'gro bar bzhed do/ 21 /theg pa che chung gi khyad par byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pas lam bgrod pa'i khyad par du 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni theg pa che chung gi khyad par sems bskyed du bzhed do/ 22 /mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang gsang bsngags kyi khyad par rgyu dang 'bras bu lam du byed pa la sogs pa tha dad par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par dbang du bzhed do/ 23 /pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang sngags gnyis gang rung des byang chub thob par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sngags (374)mtshan nyid gang med kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi 'thob par bzhed do/ 24 /sdoms pa gsum po dge ba dang mi dge ba so sor nyams su len par 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni sdom pa gsum spang bya mi dge ba'i phyogs spong bar gnad gcig tu bzhed do/ 25 /bsrung rgyu mi mthun pa nyid kyis sdom pa gsum gyi khyad par du 'gro bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi// 'dir ni bdag po 'phos pas sdom pa gsum du 'ong bar bzhed do/ 26 /bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po khams rang bzhin rnam dag ni stong pa nyid du ston pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa bral 'bras yon tan lhag par bzhed do/ 27 /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun ni theg pa gsum gyi lam kho nar ston pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bde bar gshegs pa'i snying por yod par bzhed do/ 28 /tshad med bzhi 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin kho nar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni tshad med pa bzhi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo yin par bzhed do/ 29 /theg pa rnam pa gsum ni rgyu dang lam tha dad cing 'bras bu tha dad gsum du nges par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni theg pa thams cad rigs gcig theg pa gcig tu bzhed do/ 30 /nyan thos dang log sred can sangs rgyas mi thob pa dang nyan thos gtan gyi gegs su gsungs pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni thub pa'i dgongs pas log sred can dang nyan thos kyang mthar byang chub chen por 'gyur bar bzhed do// chos kyi 'khor la spyi'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms rdo rje'i gsung sum cu pa ste skabs dang po'o/ ༈ /dge ba dang mi dge ba lung ma bstan gsum du bshad mod kyi/

'dir ni dge mi dge gnyis su thag bcad na lung ma bstan med par bzhed do/ 1 /rtog pa mang (375)po'am chos tha dad gcig char 'byung bar 'dod do zhes smra ba mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni rtog gnyis gcig char mi 'jug cing sems par 'grogs nas mi skye bar bzhed do/ 2 /sems gzhir gyur pa la khyad par gyi chos sems las byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sems las byung ba las sems 'byung bar bzhed do/ 3 /'khor bar 'khor ba ni sems kho na yin par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'khor bar lus 'khor bar bzhed do/ 4 /rten 'brel bcu gnyis la ma rig pa cha gcig tu 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis ma rig pa'i g.yos su bzhed do/ 5 /rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni cha gsum dum bu gsum du rdzogs par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis skad cig ma gcig la tshang ba bzhed do/ 6 /lo ka'i khams kyi tshad sna tshogs dang byung tshul mi 'dra ba dag ni nges pa med par gsungs par 'dod pa yin mod kyi// 'dir ni sems tha dad pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang tha dad par bzhed do/ 7 /bde sdug thams cad ni sngon gyi las kho na pa rags las par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni da lta nyid du gang bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la longs spyod par bzhed do/ 8 /'phel 'grib kyi dus ni rang bzhin gyis byung ba las thabs kyis mi phan par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni dus kyi 'phel ba dang 'grib pa da lta rang yang byar yod par bzhed do/ 9 da ltar gyi dus su skyes nas myong 'gyur dang lan grangs gzhan la myong ba ma gtogs pa mthong chos mi 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi// 'dir ni tshe 'di rang la mthong chos gtsor 'byung bar bzhed do/ 10 /mi chos bcu drug la sogs pa ni mi chos yin la/ lha chos de las gzhan par 'dod pa yin mod kyi// 'dir ni mi chos bcu drug la sogs pa yang lha chos dang gcig yin par bzhed do/

11 /bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcu la 'bras bu'i dus sngon du song bas phyir nas (376)'bras bu thob par mi 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni phal che chung las 'bras bu thob pa rgyun ma chad par 'byung bar bzhed do/ 12 /bslab pa gsum la lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro ba yang yod par bzhed do/ 13 /bstan pa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad rim gyis nyams su blang bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni lam rim thams cad thun gcig gi nang du nyams su blang bar bzhed do/ 14 /zhing gcig tu sangs rgyas gcig las mi 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas mang po zhing gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung bar bzhed do/ 15 /rten 'brel kun la phan pa pas rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga pa ste skabs gnyis pa'o/ ༈ 1 /'ga' zhig gi lugs kyis dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sde snod 'di theg pa chung ngur 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'dul ba theg pa thun mong yin par bzhed do/ 2 /'dul ba ni theg pa chung ngu 'ba' zhig tu nges pas theg pa chen po ma yin par 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni lhag par theg pa chen por bzhugs pa gsal bar bzhed do/ 3 /dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa'i tshul khrims ni nyan thos kyi chos su 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni tshul khrims rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kho nar bzhed do/ 4 /bar du gcod pa'i chos dang ldan pa rnams la sdom pa skye bar mi 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni dge sbyong gi 'bras bu thob pa'i bar chad las sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad ma yin par bzhed do/ 5 /sdom pa'i ngo bo ni spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa la sogs pa 'dod lugs legs par 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs su bzhed do/

6 /ltung ba thams cad la 'du shes gtso ba dang dngos po gtso ba gnyis su 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni ltung ba (377)mtha' dag la bcas pa bas 'du shes gtso bar 'gyur par bzhed do/ 7 /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni spong ba bdun 'khor dang bcas par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni yid kyi rnam pa gsum gtso bor spang dgos par bzhed do/ 8 /'chi 'pho la sogs pas sdom pa gtong bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong ba yang yod par bzhed do/ 9 /pham pa gcig byung nas sdom pa thams cad 'jig ste/ dge sbyong du mi rung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bu lon nor can gyi 'dod pa ltar bzhed do/ 10 /ltung ba gcig byung na de'i nyes pas ngan 'gror ltung ba las gzhan du mi 'gyur ro zhes 'chad mod kyi/ 'dir ni sna gcig bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu kyang myang ngan las 'da' ba yin par bzhed do/ 11 /rang bzhin mi gnang bkag pa yin cing bcas pa la ni gnang bkag gi skabs yod par 'dod pa mang mod kyi// 'dir ni bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba gcig par bzhed do/ 12 /rang bzhin yod med kyi sdig pa dang ltung ba tha dad par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sdig pa dang ltung ba tha dad med cing gcig par bzhed do/ 13 /bcas pa ni bcas pa'i rten can dge slong dge bsnyen kho nas bcas par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bcas pa thams cad 'gro drug spyi la bcas pa bzhed do/ 14 /'gro ba gzhan dag la bcas pa la 'das kyang nyes pa med par 'dod par yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das kyang nyes dmigs 'byung bar bzhed do/ 15 /bslab pa blangs pas bcas pa bsrung na phan yon du 'gyur la// gzhan lam yin par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'gro drug gang gis bsrungs kyang phan yon che bar bzhed do/ 16 /bcas pa ni rkyen la ltos pas dgag bcas ni gnang ba'i tshe na nyes med du 'gyur bar 'dod pa yod mod kyi/

'dir ni bkag pa ni (378)nyes med du 'gyur mi srid pas spyir bkag pa thams cad ye bkag la gnang ba ye gnang du bzhed do/ 17 /chos med par bsrungs kyang chog par 'dod pa 'ga' zhig 'byung ngo zhes grags mod kyi/ 'dir ni bstan pa la thabs la mkhas pa'i cho ga lhag par gal che bar bzhed do/ 18 /nyes pa thams cad ni chags pa dang khyad par du zhe sdang che bar 'dod la mi shes pa chung ngur bshad mod kyi/ 'dir ni mi shes pa gti mug lhag par nyes pa che bar bzhed do/ 19 /ngan 'gro'i gnas ni dmyal ba dman la dud 'gro mtho bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni dud 'gro gti mug che bas dman par 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 20 /bslab pa blangs pas nyes pa spyad pa ni lci la/ gdod nas ma thob pa ni nyes pa med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni nyams pa'i nyes pa bas ma thob pa nyes pa che zhing lci bar bzhed do/ 21 /'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus las rdo rje'i tshig nyi shu tham pa ste/ tshoms sam skabs gsum pa'o/ ༈ /theg pa chen po ni snying rjes khyad par du byas pas snying rje la byang chub kyi sems su 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems tha dad pa yin par bzhed do/ 1 /byang chub kyi sems ni skye ba'i nges pa med pas sdom pa rten can ma yin par 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni thugs nyams su myong bas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa rten can du bzhed do/ 2 /'jug pa'i sdom pa ni sa thob nas skye bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni so so skye bo la yang 'jug pa skye bar bzhed do/ 3 /sdom pa gsum po mtha' dag mthud na 'jug sdom du mi 'gyur bar tha dod pa yin mod kyi// 'dir ni ci rigs kyi tshul khrims kyis kyang sdom par 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 4 /byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba nyon mongs pa can dang*/ nyon (379)mongs pa can dang*/ nyon mongs pa ma yin pa'i ltung ba med par bzhed do// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la dge bar 'gyur bas mi dge ba rnams gnang bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni nyes par mi 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba gnang ba med par bzhed do/ 6 /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa na ma dag pa spyod pa la zer bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la mi dge ba med/ yod na mi dge ba de'i 'bras bu de nyid du 'byung bar 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 7 /snying rje chen pos gzhan don du smon lam 'debs pa dang rang bzhin gyi sdug bsngal brje bar gsungs pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni thabs la ma mkhas na rang gzhan brje ba de nyid nyes par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod par yang bzhed do/ 8 /yul byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas pa'i rgyu 'bras bu bde bar 'brel bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni gnod pa'i rgyus byang chub sems dpa'i gnod pa la bde ba 'brel mi srid par bzhed do/ 9 /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs nas rdzogs byed mi dge bas rdzogs pas rgyu 'bras tha dad du 'dod pa yon mod kyi/ 'dir ni rgyu 'bras mi 'dre bar dge mi dge'i 'bras bu nges par so sor 'byung bar bzhed do/ 10 /nag po'i chos bzhi la sogs pa pham pa dang 'dra ba'i nyes pa rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems 'chor bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni brjed par 'gyur ba las byang chub kyi sems 'chor mi srid par bzhed do/ 11 /sgrib pa gsum tha dad par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sgrib pa gsum nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa 'ba' zhig tu gcig par bzhed do/ 12 /chos nyid kyi bden pa ni grub mtha' ngan pa bkag nas bzang po khong du chud pas rtogs par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bden pa ni grub pa'i mtha' ji snyed pa thams cad kyis sgrib par bzhed do// (380) 13 /nyan thos kyi grub mtha' ni bden pa ma yin par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni nyan thos kyi grub mtha' yang phyogs gcig babs kyi gnas lugs rtogs par bzhed do/ 14 /sems tsam kyis ni chos nyid stong pa nyid rtogs par mi nus par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni sems tsam pa ni sa bdun gyis mngon rtogs ring du song bar bzhed do/ 15 /sa dang po nas bdag med gnyis rtogs par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kyi bdag med pas brgyad pa la mngon du byas te mi 'gal bar bzhed do/ 16 /mngon par rtogs pa mthong lam dang dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i rim pa tha dad kyis lam bgrod par 'dod pa yin mod kyi// 'dir ni rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus pa bgrod par bzhed do/ 17 /sa thob ma thag tu yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs pa 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sa sbyongs pa'i yon tan 'byung ba'i tshul mu drug la sogs par bzhed do/ 18 /rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa las 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug par bzhed do/ 19 /sa dang po yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis ma mthong bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sa drug man chad nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang mngon rtogs thun mongs du bzhed do/ 20 /theg pa che chung gi bye brag gis tshogs gsog pa'i zhing la khyad par yod par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mtho dman gang du yang zhing yar gdams pa gnad zab par bzhed do/ 21 /bdag 'dzin med pas 'khor ba las 'da' bas bdag 'dzin spong bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa la ched du bdag tu bzung nas tshogs bsags na thabs mkhas par bzhed do/ 22 /dge ba'i rtsa ba rang gis ci ltar byas pa'i bsngo ba byed par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bsngo bar bzhed do// (381) 23 /sangs rgyas dang bla ma dam pa la bsngo ba mi dgos par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni phrin las rdzogs par 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas dang bla ma la yang bsngo ba dgos par bzhed do/ 24

/bslab pa byang chub sems dpa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyer bzhi pa ste skabs bzhi pa'o// ༈ //sngags ni bstan pa gzhan la mi 'byung bar gsung mod kyi// 'dir ni gdul bya'i khyad par las sngags ni bstan pa gzhan la yang 'byung bar bzhed do/ 1 /gsang sngags kyi dbang thob pa'i go ba cho gas bskur ba la byed mod kyi/ 'dir ni mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla mas bskur ba'i dbang gi don rgyud la skyes na thob par bzhed do/ 2 /dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rigs tha dad ma tshang na dbang bskur du mi 'gro bar 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni lha phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur du 'gro bar bzhed do/ 3 /dbang gsum pa dpe don mi mthun par sten pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni dpe don rtogs pa ma skyes na khong du mi chud par bzhed do/ 4 /bskyed rim ma yin la brtags pa kun btags su 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bskyed rim ni yongs grub par bzhed do/ 5 /snga ma'i las 'phro sad pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang byung du 'byung ba la sogs pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga mi dgos pas de nyid nyams su blangs pas chog par 'dod yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rang byung rnams la 'jug pa'i cho ga gal che bar bzhed do/ 6 /sngags kyi lha rnams zhal phyag tha dad pa gdul bya dang 'dra bar 'dod mod kyi// 'dir ni lha thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang ldan par bzhed do/ 7 /de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sku mthong ba gtso bor byed pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni lha la sogs pa mdo rgyud du gsungs pa gtsor bya dgos par bzhed do/ 8 /skad (382)cig dran rdzogs bsgom pa ni dbang po rab yin la/ cho ga mang po ni tha ma yin pas chod mi che bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa thams cad lhag par dgos shing gal che bar bzhed do/ 9 /cho ga rgyas pa thams cad drang don du spros pa la dga' ba la gsungs pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni spros pa thams cad babs kyi rten 'brel du 'byung bar bzhed do/ 10 /rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs ni rtsa rlung thig le byang chub sems la 'dod mod kyi// 'dir ni rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs ni zab mo'i 'khor lor bzhed do/ 11 /rtsa rlung byang chub kyi gnas lugs kyang gzhung du bshad pa ltar 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni gnas lugs 'ga' zhig rdo rje 'chang gis sbas par bzhed do/ 12 /khyad par du rtsa rlung ni gsang ba sngags kho na zab mo yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'dug tshul dang las 'ga' zhig sman zab par bzhed do/ 13 /sdom pa gsum la sogs pa bas rtsa rlung gi man ngag dang gdams pa chung zab par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni gzhan pa gyis mi zab pa zab par bzhed do/ 14 /zab mo rtsa rlung gis bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu sku de yongs su 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mi zab pa'i gdams ngag med na zab mo rtsa rlung gis sangs mi rgya bar bzhed do/ 15 /bka' dang bstan bcos rnams las ma bshad pa zhig myong ngam rtogs na khyad chos su 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyams myong ni log rtogs su bzhed do/ 16 /drang don dang nges don tha dad du rtogs pas phyogs re re mthun pas chog par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bka'i dgongs pa thams cad dang 'gal med du 'gro dgos par bzhed do/ 17 /nyams su blangs pa'i skyon yon ni gdams ngag zab mo (383)rnams kho na ltar 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni gdams ngag ltar mi 'ong bka' ltar 'ong bar bzhed do/ 18 /sku gsum gyi rgyu ni skyon med pa'i ting nge 'dzin du 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni skyon med kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyur bzhed do/ 19 /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs par sprul pa'i sku dang longs sku la sogs pa sku gsum tha dad par bshad mod kyi/

'dir ni sku gsum re re yang sku gsum ka'i bdag nyid du bzhed do/ 20 /sngags ni rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa yin pas thub pa'i dgongs pa 'dul ba mi dgos par 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni sngags la tshul khrims med kha med du bzhed do/ 21 /gsang sngags ni 'dod pa spyod pas grub par gsungs pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'dod pas bar du gcod par gsungs pa'i steng du gcig par bzhed do/ 22 /gsang sngags ni gzhi nyon mongs pa dug gsum bsgyur ba'i lam par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sngags kyi mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur ba'i gnas med par bzhed do/ 23 /gsang sngags ni mi dge ba yang thabs mkhas pas spyad pas dge bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'dul bar dge ba de sngags su yang dge la 'dul bar mi dge ba de sngags su yang mi dge bar 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 24 /nyon mongs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang gdung du bzhed pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni nyon mongs pa dag pa'i 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa yin par bzhed do/ 25 /gsang sngags mngon spyod kyi phrin las sdig tu mi 'gyur te dge bar 'gyur bas gnang bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sngags kyi mthu bstan pa las mngon spyod ma gnang bar bzhed do/ 26 /rdo rje dmyal ba ni dmyal ba gzhan las lhag par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rdo rje dmyal ba (384)ni mnar med la sogs nyid yin par bzhed do/ 27 /nam mkha' ma zhig gi bar du mi thon par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rdo rje slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho na de nyid kyis 'drongs par bzhed do/ 28 /gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms las rdo rje'i gsung nyer brgyad pa ste skabs lnga pa'o// ༈ //'ga' zhig ni chos brgyud pa med mar 'byung ba dang*/ sa chos/ gnam chos gter ma la sogs pa zab cing ngo mtshar bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar bar bzhed do/

1 /snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba rnams ni/ nang gi blo dang ma 'brel bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems su bzhed do/ 2 /'khor 'das kyi rgyu 'bras thams cad ni dus yun ring po la ltos par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos thams cad bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs su bzhed do/ 3 /rang bzhin gcig tu ma nges pas gang ltar bltas pa de ltar 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni gshis la mi gnas ni bltas pas mi 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 4 /mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i bla mas kyang yon tan skyed nus par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni mtshan nyid mi ldan pa'i bla mas yon tan bskyed mi nus par bzhed do/ 5 /rtogs pa skye ba'i thabs ma nges pa sna tshogs su 'byung ba yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rtogs pa skye bar byed pa'i thabs mos gus kho nar nges par bzhed do/ 6 /dbu ma chen po la sogs pa ni lta ba mtha' thug tu 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rtogs pa phul du phyin pa la lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan par bzhed do/ 7 /chos nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pa ni chen po gsum kho na mtho bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni (385)chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs par bzhed do/ 8 /thos bsam sgom gsum las byung ba'i rtogs rnams ni rtogs par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni thos bsam sgom gsum gyi stong nyid de dag thams cad ni shor sa dang gol sar bzhed do/ 9 /sgom pa ni bde gsal mi rtogs pa la sogs pa zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la byed mod kyi/ 'dir ni rtogs pa'i lam goms par byed pa bsgom par bzhed do/ 10 /lta ba ni chos nyid stong pa nyid phyag rgya chen po yin la/ spyod pa ni dge sdig gi blang dor dang bral bar 'dod mod kyi// 'dir ni spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba tshul khrims rin po cher bzhed do/

11 /mthar thug phyag rgya chen po dang*/ tshul khrims gnyis ni 'gal ba'i chos su 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims rin po che gcig pa mgon po'i khyad chos bla na med par bzhed do/ 12 /lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa gsum tha dad par 'dod pa mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni lta sgom spyod pa gsum gcig par bzhed do/ 13 /phyag rgya chen po la skyon yon gang yang med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni phyag rgya chen po yon tan gyi bdag nyid du bzhed do/ 14 /mnyam bzhag la ni yon tan mi 'byung la rjes la 'byung bar 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni mnyam bzhag nyid las yon tan thams cad 'byung bar bzhed do/ 15 /rgyu ma bsgrubs kyang yon tan thams cad 'byung bar 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni rgyu ma bsgrubs na ni thams cad mi 'byung bar bzhed do/ 16 /stong nyid rtogs nas rgyu 'bras zad pas zad sar skyol bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni stong nyid rtogs nas stong pa nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung bar bzhed do/ 17 /rtogs pa yod phyin thabs lam la sogs pa la dgos pa med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rtogs (386)pa dang ldan pa la thabs lam la sogs pa shin tu yang dgos par bzhed do/ 18 /rtogs pa'i bogs 'don pa la rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa sna tshogs pa rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs kyis dur khrod du rol bar 'dod pa yin mod kyis/ 'dir ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la lhag par gces spras su byed pa rig spyod khyad par du 'phags par bzhed do/ 19 /mnyam bzhag chen po bhu su ku ni mthar thug pa'i spyod pa yin par 'dod mod kyis/ 'dir ni bhu su ku chos gsum med na zhig spyod pa dang khyad par med par bzhed do/ 20 /khyad par lta spyod sgom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu tham pa ste skabs drug pa'o// ༈ //sangs rgyas kyi sar bden pa gnyis yod par 'dod pa yin te/

'dir ni sangs rgyas kyi sar bden pa gnyis su med par bzhed do/ 1 /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni yod par 'dod pa dang med par 'dod pa gnyis kho na yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni ye shes ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho nar bzhed do/ 2 /mya ngan las 'das pa las ches lhag pa'i chos shig yod na yang sgyu ma lta bu yin pas sgyu ma yod par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sgyu ma lta bu'i chos las yang dag par 'das par bzhed do/ 3 /sangs rgyas kyi thugs skad cig gnyis las phan chad ni tshad mar mi 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas dus rtag tu tshad mar bzhugs par bzhed do/ 4 /sangs rgyas la ni shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs nas thugs kyi 'jug pa 'ched par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni bral ba'i 'bras bu ye shes kyi thugs can du bzhed do/ 5 /chos sku ni gnyis kyis bsdus pa las 'das pas rgyu rkyen zad par 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kyi sku'i yon tan phrin las mdzad pa dang bcas par bzhed do/ 6 /sangs (387)rgyas ni 'bras bu mthar phyin pas rgyu la mi 'jug par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas kyi sar yang thugs bskyed yod par bzhed do/ 7 /sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni rnam 'phrul tsam du 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni thugs gcig pu yang rtag chad kyi lta ba tshun chad du 'byung bar bzhed do/ 8 /sangs rgyas ni gzhan gyis ma yin te sangs rgyas kyi sprul pas 'gro don byed par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par bzhed do/ 9 /sangs rgyas ni zhing tha dad pa re re sangs rgyas par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kyi dbyings thams cad du sangs ma rgyas na sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 10 /sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa mtha' yas pa 'gyed pa la rgyu med kyang sprul pas chog par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni rgyu med kyi sprul pa mi srid pas rang rgyud par bzhed do/ 11 /sku gnyis dang ye shes ni gzhan snang du 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas rten 'brel gyi sku yin par bzhed do/ 12 /smon pa'i 'bras bu ni sprul sku yin la 'jug pa las longs sku 'byung bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni smon pa las longs sku dang 'jug pa las sprul sku 'byung bar gsung so/ 13 /sku gsum ni gnas tha dad na 'khor tha dad la chos tha dad par ston pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sku gsum tha dad med par bzhugs par bzhed do/ 14 /sangs rgyas thams cad ni 'og min nam de lta bu'i gnas na bzhugs par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas thams cad sems can gyi khams rgyud la bzhugs par bzhed do/ 15 /'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i gnad bsdus las rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga pa ste skabs bdun pa'o// ༈ //(388)'di rnams ni bzhed pa chen por grags pa yin te/ de re re la yang bye brag gi bzhed lugs mtha' yas par 'gro bas/ bzhed pa 'di dag gi phyag rgyas thebs shing gzhig 'grel tshud pas thub pa'i bka' mtha' dag gi dgongs pa dang mthun par rang nyid rgyud thog tu sbyor shes shing go bar gyur pa de dag gis/ pha mnyam pa med pa'i mgon po 'bri gung pa de'i thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ chos kyi bgo skal la longs spyod pa bsam gyi mi khyab cing rmad du byung ba'o// de rnams ni bzhed pa'i zhal gdams kyi tshoms te skabs brgyad pa'o// ༈ //ji ltar 'jig rten 'di na pha yi bu// longs spyod phal pa'i 'byor pa ldan gyur kyang*// pha yi khyod nor gzhan la med pa dag /ma thos mi 'dzin de ni dmad pa ltar// de bzhin mtshungs med 'jig rten mgon po yis// mngon du mdzad pa'i khyad par chos 'di dag /sngon chad ma grags phyi dus 'jig rten 'dir// rjes 'brangs sras kyis mi 'dzin de dang mtshungs// de phyir rigs ldan pha yi gdung 'tshob pa// rigs 'chol gzhan la smon par mi byed cing*// grags ldan de yis bzhed pa'i thugs dgongs rnams// nan tan chen pos 'dzin na ngo mtshar che// bstan 'dzin chos mdzad skyes bu dam pa rnams// bu stong nang du 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi// mtshan ldan sras ni khyad par 'phags pa bzhin// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kun gyi nang na mdzes// thun mongs ma yin gdams pa'i snying po dang*// rab 'byams thub pa'i bka' la ma rmongs pas// phyi rol rgol ba ngan pa'i wa tshogs kyis// gangs chen seng ge lta bur nyam nga med// rigs mthun 'khor dang sna tshogs gdul bya la// ma 'dres (389)chos kyi khyad par legs bstan pa// dman dang mchog gi bye brag rab phye ste// snyan pa'i sgra chen 'brug sgra phyogs bcur sgrogs// de ltar zab cing rgya chen bla med pa'i// dgongs pa rgya mtsho che ltar yangs pa las// skra rtses chu thigs tsam zhig smos pa 'di// ban ldom shes rab 'byung gnas bdag gis bris// rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba des// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// 'jig rten mi shes gti mug rnam bral zhing*// mthar phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog

/phas byas bsags pa mthar phyin gyi khyad nor brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba/ dpal gyi 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas nas byung ba rdzogs so// ༈ //rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa'i ngag 'don mdor bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/// /dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i gzhung rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa zhes bya ba/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo// dri med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// ma 'dres shes bya'i dngos po ji lta ba// thams cad gzigs pa kun chen chos kyi rje// mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba mchog gi zhal nas gsungs pa yi// dam chos khyad par 'phags thun mongs ma yin pa// mngon du mdzad pa'i bzhed tshul dpag med kyang*// rmongs pas dran pa cung zad tsam zhig 'bri// chos kun gshis sam bab kyi gnas lugs bstan// chos phung brgyad khri sangs rgyas bsgrub par gcig /sde snod rgyud sde lam gyi rim pa yin// chos 'khor rnam gsum 'khor gyi rtog pa'i khyad// 'khor lo re re la yang gsum ka tshang*// phyi ma'i (390)sa bon snga ma snga mar gnas// mdo don gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du nges// 'dul ba'i sde snod bden bzhi'i chos 'khor te// theg pa sna tshogs nges don 'khor lo yin// mtha' drug dgongs pa nges don 'ba' zhig bzhed// sems tsam bka' yis mtha' bral dbu ma ston// log pa'i kun rdzob kyis kyang don byed nus// ji snyed lam rnams sa bcus bgrod pa ste// de yang rim gyis 'jug pa kho nar nges// shes bya'i sgrib pa thog mar spong ba'ang yod// tshad ma sangs rgyas kun mkhyen ye shes te// tshad ma'i 'bras bu zab mo stong nyid ston// grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud pa// mu stegs pa la'ang dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang*// phyi nang khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed pa ste// theg pa che chung khyad par sems bskyed yin// mdo dang sngags kyi khyad par dbang yin te// de gnyis gang med rdzogs byang thob mi srid// sdom gsum mi dge bcu spong gnad gcig la// bdag po 'phos pas sdom pa gsum du 'ong*// rang bzhin rnam dag bral 'bras yon tan ldan// byang phyogs so bdun bde gshegs snying por yod// tshad med rnam bzhi sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// theg pa thams cad rigs gcig theg pa gcig

/nyan rang log sred can yang rnam mkhyen 'gyur// chos 'khor gnod bsdus kyi skabs te dang po'o/// /dge sdig gnyis las lung ma bstan gzhan med// rtog gnyis gcig car 'jug pa mi srid la// sems byung las kyang sems ni 'byung ba'ang yod// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor lus nyid 'khor bar bzhed// rten 'brel bcu gnyis ma rig kho na'i g.yos// bcu gnyis de yang skad cig gcig la tshang*// sems ni tha dad dbang gis snang ba yang*// da ltar nyid du ma bsgrubs (391)'bras bur spyod// dus kyi 'phel 'grig da ltar byar yod yin// tshe 'di rang la mthong chos gtso bor 'byung*// mi chos bcu drug lha chos gnad gcig ste// gtso phal tsam las 'bras thob rgyun chad med// shes rab bslab pa thog mar 'gro ba'ang yod// lam rim thams cad thun gcig nyams len dgos// zhing gcig la yang sangs rgyas grangs med 'byon// rten 'brel gnad bsdus kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o/// /dam chos 'dul ba theg pa thun mong ste// lhag par theg pa chen por gsal bzhugs la// tshul khrims thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin// bar chad ldan la'ang sdom pa skye ba ste// ngo bo rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs// ltung ba mtha' dag la ni 'du shes gtso// yid kyi rnam gsum gtso bor spong ba dgos// gtong ba'i rgyu yis mi gtong ba yang yod// pham pa bzhi ni bu yon nor can bzhin// sna gcig bsrungs pas 'bras bu myang 'das thob// bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho gcig /sdig ltung tha dad med cing gcig pa yin// bkag pa ye bkag gnang ba ye gnang la// chos kyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas// 'gro ba gang gis 'das kyang nyes pa dang*// srung ba'i phan yon yang ni kun la 'byung*// bstan la cho ga lhag par gal che la// mi shes gti mug nyes pa gzhan las lci// dud 'gro gti mug che bas dman pa yin// nyams las ma thob nyes pa che bar bshad// so thar gnad bsdus kyi skabs te gsum pa'o/// /byang chub sems dang snying rje tha dad yin// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rten can bzhed// so so skye bo la yang 'jug sdom skye// ci rigs kyis kyang 'jug pa'i sdom par (392)'gyur// nyon mongs can min ltung ba mi srid cing*// nyes par mi 'gyur mi dge gnang ba med// thabs mkhas spyod la mi dge yod ma yin// rang gzhan brje ba nyes par 'gyur skabs yod// sems dpar gnod byas bde bar mi 'brel zhing*// dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu so sor 'byung*// byang chub sems ni brjed la 'chor mi srid// sgrib pa rnam gsum nyon mongs sgrib par gcig

/ji snyed grub mthas don dam bden pa bsgribs// nyan thos rnams kyis gnas lugs phyogs gcig mthong*// sa drug man chad nyan rang thun mong ste// sems tsam pa ni sa bdun mngon rtogs yin// chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad mngon du byas// rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod// sa thob yon tan 'byung tshul mu drug yod// gzhi lam 'bras bur tshogs gnyis zung 'jug ste// mtho dman kun tu zhing ni gdams pa zab// bdag tu bzung ste tshogs bsags thabs mkhas bzhed// 'khor 'das kun gyi bsags yod dge ba bsngo// sangs rgyas bla ma la yangs sngo ba dgos// byang sems gnad bsdus kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o/// /gsang sngags bstan pa gzhan la'ang 'byung ba yod// dbang don rgyud la skyes na thob par bzhed// lha ni phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur 'gro// rtogs pa ma skyes dpe don khong mi chud// bskyed pa'i rim pa gdod nas yongs su grub// rang byung rnams la 'jug pa'i cho ga dgos// lha rnams thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan ldan// mdo rgyud las gsungs lha rnams gtso bor bya// dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa dgos// spros pa thams cad bab kyi rten 'brel yin// rdo rje'i lus (393)ni zab mo'i 'khor lor bzhed// gnas lugs 'ga' zhig rdo rje 'chang gis sbas// las dang 'dug tshul 'ga' zhig sman rgyud zab// gzhan gyis mi zab pa rnams 'dir zab ste// de med rtsa rlung gdams pas sangs mi rgya// bka' dang 'gal ba'i nyams myong log rtog yin// dgongs pa thams cad 'gal med shes par bya// gdams ngag ltar min bka' ltar 'ong bar bzhed// skyon med ting 'dzin khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu// sku gsum re re la yang gzhan gnyis tshad// gsang sngags la ni tshul khrims med ka med// 'dod pas bar du gcod par mdo sngags gcig /sngags kyi mi dge dge bar 'gyur skabs med// 'dul bar mi dge sngags su'ang dger mi 'gyur// nyon mongs dag 'bras bde bar gshegs pa nyid// mthu bstan tsam las mngon spyod gnang ba med// rdo rje dmyal ba mnar med la sogs yin// slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho na myur du 'dren// gsang sngags gnad bsdus kyi skabs te lnga pa'o/// /dam pa'i chos gang brgyud par 'brel pa zab// 'khor 'das chos kun rang gi sems snang tsam// rgyu 'bras skad cig bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin// gshis la mi gnas bltas pas 'gyur mi srid// mtshan nyid mi ldan yon tan skyed mi nus// rtogs pa skyed thabs mos gus kho nar nges// lta ba'i mchog gyur rtogs pa dang ldan pa// chen po gsum gyis ma reg rtogs pa'i mchog

/thos bsam sgom pa'i stong nyid gol shor yin// rtogs pa goms par byed pa sgom pa ste// spyod pa blang dor bral ba tshul khrims bzhed// lta sgom spyod gsum tha dad med par gcig /(394)phyag chen tshul khrims gnad gcig khyad par chos// phyag chen yon tan kun gyi bdag nyid de// mnyam par bzhag las yon tan thams cad 'byung*// rgyu ni ma bsgrubs yon tan 'byung mi srid// stong nyid rtogs na rgyu 'bras nyid du ldang*// rtogs ldan la yang thabs lam lhag par dgos// rig spyod khyad du 'phags pa tshul khrims yin// chos gsum mi ldan nyid rang khyad par med// lta sgom spyod pa gnad bsdus kyi skabs te drug pa'o/// /sangs rgyas sa na bden gnyis rnam dbyer med// mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis med mtha' dang bral// sgyu ma lta bu'i chos las yang dag 'das// sangs rgyas dus na rtag tu tshad mar bzhugs// bral ba'i 'bras bu ye shes thugs can bzhed// chos sku yon tan mdzad pa phrin las bcas// mtha' thug sangs rgyas sa na'ang thugs bskyed yod// thugs ni rtag chad lta ba tshun la 'di 'byung*// shes byar srid tshad sangs rgyas bya ba byed// chos dbyings kun tu 'tshang rgya dgos par bzhed// rgyu med sprul pa mi srid rang rgyud pa// sangs rgyas zhes bya rten cing 'brel 'byung sku// smon 'jug longs sprul rgyu ru bzhed pa'ang yod// sku gsum tha dad med par bzhugs pa yin// sangs rgyas thams cad sems can rgyud la bzhugs// 'bras bu gnad bsdus kyi skabs te bdun pa'o/// /ji ltar 'jig rten 'di na pha yi bu// longs spyod phal pa'i 'byor pa ldan gyur kyang*// pha yi khyad nor gzhan la med pa dag /ma thos mi 'dzin de ni smad pa ltar// de bzhin mtshungs med 'jig rten mgon po yis// mngon du mdzad pa'i khyad par chos 'di dag /sngon chad ma grags phyi dus 'jig rten 'dir// rje 'brangs sras kyis mi 'dzin de dang mtshungs// de (395)phyir rigs ldan pha yi gdung 'tshob pa// rigs 'chol gzhan la smon pa mi byed par// grags ldan de yi bzhed pa'i thugs dgongs rnams// nan tan chen pos 'dzin na ngo mtshar che// bstan 'dzin chos mdzad skyes bu dam pa rnams// bu stong nang du 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyi// mtshan ldan sras ni khyad par 'phags pa bzhin// bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kun gyi nang na mdzes// thun mongs ma yin gdams pa'i snying po dang*// rab 'byams thub pa'i bka' la ma rmongs pas// phyi rol rgol ba ngan pa'i wa tshogs kyis// gangs can seng ge lta bur nyam nga med// rigs mthun 'khor dang sna tshogs gdul bya la// ma 'dres chos kyi khyad par legs bstan pa// dman dang mchog gis bye brag rab phye ste// snyan pa'i sgra chen 'brug sgra phyogs bcur sgrogs// de ltar zab cing rgya che bla med pa'i// dgongs pa rgya mtsho che ltar yongs pa las// skra rtse'i chu thigs tsam zhig smras pa 'di// ban sdom shes rab 'byung gnas bdag gis bris// rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba 'dis// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// 'jig rten mi shes gti mug rnam bral zhing*// mtha' phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog

/ces pa 'di ni spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung de nyid sor bzhag la// rang gzhan 'jug pa bde phyir du rdo rje'i gsung tshigs bcad du bsdebs te// chos kyi rje skyob pa yab sras kyi bstan pa la dad pa'i blo can dkon mchog rin chen phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes khyi lo hor zla dang po'i nyer gsum la khams kyi be ri thang gi sgar thog tu bris pa dge/ ༈ /rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa'i lhan thabs bzhi bcu (396)bcu rtsa bdun pa bzhugs so// dri med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// ma 'dres shes bya'i dngos po ci lta bar// thams cad gzigs pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje// mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi 'dren pa rnams las yon tan bkod pa kun gyis khyad par du 'phags pas dus gsum khegs pa'i ston pa// chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyal ba thams cad kyis dus rtag par yon tan bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pas/ sku che ba'i yon tan gyi grags pa 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad bkram pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa re re zhing yang shes bya'i mthar thug pa brnyes pas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par dpe zla thams cad dang bral ba// 'jig rten phyogs bcu khyab par phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa dus rtag par bzhugs pas 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa chos thams cad la dbang sgyur zhing dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa rin po che'i tshul khrims kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pas/ chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po// mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma/ khams gsum gyi mgon po// chos kyi rje 'bri khung gling pa de'i zhal nas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bstan pa ni mi 'dra ba tha dad pa sna tshogs su 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos dang bstan pa'i babs ni gcig par bzhed do/

1 /'ga' zhig na re sangs rgyas chos tha dad pa dang grub mtha' nges pa can yin ces zer/ 'dir ni theg pa dang grub mtha' sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel yin par bzhed do/ 2 /spyir chos kyi phung po'i tshad ni bal glang gi rgyal khal la sogs pa yin par 'dod na yang*/ 'dir ni brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs pa'i (397)gnyen por bzhed do/ 3 /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ni so sor ma 'dres par tha dad du 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni gcig gi nang du yang bcu gnyis po thams cad ci rigs su tshang bar bzhed do/ 4 /phun sum tshogs pa lngas ni bka' min pa la ma khyab par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'khor 'das thams cad kyang phun sum tshogs pa lngas bsdus par bzhed do/ 5 /sde snod gsum so so yin te gcig la gcig thug reg med pa 'dod de/ 'dir ni phan tshun 'brel pa can gyi tshul du 'dres can du gsungs te re re'i nang du yang gsum ka tshang bar bzhed do/ 6 /spyir gsung rab thams cad kyi gleng gzhi la chos phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang zer te/ 'dir ni bka' thams cad la phun sum tshogs pa lnga shin tu yang tshang bar bzhed do/ 7 /'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa gsum la 'dod lugs mang na yang*/ 'dir ni thun mong gi mdo dang sems tsam bstan pa'i bka' ni mngon pa'i sde snod du bzhed do/ 8 /mu stegs dang bon gyi sgor zhugs pas bden pa mthong bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mu stegs dang bon gyi sgor zhugs pas bden pa mthong ba'i gnas med par bzhed do/ 9 /mu stegs dang bon la thar pa cha mthun tsam yang med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ni yod pa mi 'gal bar bzhed do/ 10 /phyi rol pa la sdom pa dang snying rje gang yang yod pa ma yin te mu stegs kyi nyams su blang bya thams cad spong bya yin zhes zer/ 'dir ni sdom pa bsrung ba dang snying phyir rol pa la yang yod par bzhed do/

11 /rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pas ni grangs med gsum gyis sangs rgya bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rgyu mtshan (398)nyid kyi theg pas kyang tshe gcig gi sangs rgya bar yod par bzhed do/ 12 /mtshan nyid dang sngags kyi sangs rgyas de mi gcig par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos dang nyams len gyi 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig par bzhed do/ 13 /sdom pa gsum gong nas gong du yongs su 'gro bar 'dod par yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sdom pa gsum gong nas gong du dog du 'gro bar bzhed do/ 14 /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum bcu rtsa bdun ni lam gyi chos yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis ni de'i pha rol na yod par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad tshogs lam gyi ngo bos bgrod par bzhed do/ 15 /nyan rang ni theg chen gyi rigs chad pas sangs mi rgya bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni nyan rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang ldan pas mthar thug /byang chub chen por 'gyur bar bzhed do/ 16 /theg pa dang grub mtha' ma nges pa sna tshogs su yod par 'dod de/ theg pa dang grub mtha' thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel yin par bzhed do/ 17 /'khor ba mtha' yod du 'dod pa dang mtha' med du 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni 'khor ba mtha' med spros pa med par bzhed do/ 18 /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa rnams spang bya re re'i gnyen por 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni chos kun so sor thar sdom re rer 'du bar bzhed do/ 19 /dam pa'i chos 'dul ba ni sde pa bzhi la mi 'dra ba re re yod pa 'dod par yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sde pa bzhi char gyi rtsa ba'i lung sde bzhi ngo bo gcig par bzhed do/ 20 /rmi lam du sa bon nyams pa la nyes pa med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sgrub pas nus pa las rmi (399)lam du nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung bar bzhed do/

21 /sa dang po thob nas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni sa thob kyang ngan song du song ba yod par bzhed do/ 22 /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs ni mar la gsag par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni nyams len rmad du byung ba ku sā la'i tshogs gsog yin par bzhed do/ 23 /sgrub pa byed pa la sogs pa'i dus su nad dang gnod pa byung na phyi nang rten 'brel gyis phan par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni de rnams sel ba'i thabs mchog lam gtong dang dmigs pa yin par bzhed do/ 24 ༈ /gsang sngags ni sde snod bzhi pa yin pa la sogs 'dod lugs mang mod kyi/ 'dir ni sde snod gsum ka dang gsum char gyi snying po yin par bzhed do/ 25 /gsang sngags kyi dbang ni bskur yang mi 'thob pa dang ma bskur yang thob par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni dbang po rab 'bring gsum ka la brgyud pa'i cho ga zab pas dgos par bzhed do/ 26 /sku gsum gyi mdzad pa gsum du nges par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni de yang yin te lha gcig gis kyang phrin las thams cad 'grub par bzhed do/ 27 /lha re la mtshan nges pa can re re yod par 'dod pa yin 'dir ni lha thams cad kyi mtshan lhag pa'i lhas gzung bar bzhed do/ 28 /gsang sngags nas dus bzhir rtsa ba'i dam tshig gnang ba 'dod mo yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni dus bzhir rtsa ba'i dam tshig gnang ba'i dus skabs med par bzhed do/ 29 /'ga' zhig na re lha la dang po nas 'jug tu mi btub ste rim gyis 'jug pa yin zer/ 'dir ni lha la gcig char du 'jug pa gnad zab pa bzhed do/ 30 /bskyed rim brtan par byed pa la bsnyen pa'i grangs gtso bar 'dod (400)pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni lha rten 'brel gyi tshogs pas 'grub par shes dgos par bzhed do/ 31 /dka' thub la sogs pa ni lha la brnyes par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni tha mal gyi lus su btags pas dmad par bzhed do/

32 /rgyud sde bzhi la sngon ma gsum po drang don yin pas mi zab par 'dod bla med gcig su zab pas nges don yin par 'dod mod kyi/ 'dir ni drang don nges don thams cad la cho ga rgyas pa de dgos par bzhed do/ 33 /dbang ni dang po nas cho ga rgyas pa gcig gi sgor 'jug dgos par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni gang gis 'dul bar gyur na bsdus par yang bzhed do/ 34 /srung ba'i 'khor lo ni khro bo dang rdo rje rwa ba la sogs pa zab par 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni srung ba'i 'khor lo rmad du byung ba byang chub kyi go cha yin par bzhed do/ 35 /gsang sngags kyi nyams len rmad du byung ba thun mongs ma yin pa ni rtsa rlung gi gdams ngag shin tu zab par 'dod de/ 'dir ni rtsa rlung gi gnad lhag par yang 'dul ba che bar bzhed do/ 36 /dus gsum gyi byed pas rtsa rlung thig le gsum ma dag pa dag par byed dgos zer ba la mthun te/ 'dir ni snyigs ma dug bcas kyi rtsa rlung thig le khyad par du zab par bzhed do/ 37 /slob ma'i dam tshig shin tu gnyan la slob dpon gyi dam tshig mi gnyan par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni dpon slob gnyis ka phan tshun dam tshig mnyam par bzhed do/ 38 ༈ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa de sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang phyogs re zur re tsam las ma mthong bar 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni byin rlabs dang ldan pas kun gzhi dus gzhan du yang mthong bar bzhed do/ 39 /chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong nas dkar po zang yag gi lam du 'dod (401)pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mi dge ba spyod nas bcu pa yang ngan 'gror ltung bar bzhed do/ 40 /bslab pa gsum gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i yang lam rim 'dul ba phar phyin gsang sngags gsum lam mi gcig par 'dod pa yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni pha rol phyin pa drug theg pa gsum char gyi lam du bzhed do/ 41 /phyag rgya chen po la dge mi dge gnyis kas sgrib par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/

'dir ni dge ba'i ngo bos chos sku la sgrib mi srid par bzhed do/ 42 /bral ba'i 'bras bu la rgyu med par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rgyu med kyi 'bras bu mi srid par bzhed do// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med nam mkha' gnyis 'dres ni mthar thug tu 'dod pa yin gyi/ 'dir ni spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs su bzhed do/ 43 /rlung gi rtsol ba sbyor ba bzhi ldan la sogs pa zab par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni rlung mi 'dzin lhug par 'jog pa gnad zab par bzhed do/ 44 /'pho ba ni hūm̐ ngam yig 'bru la brten nas bla ma'am/ yi dam gyi thugs kar 'pho bar 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni mchog gi 'pho ba rnam shes bla ma 'od gsal bya bar bzhed do// sangs rgyas ni mya ngan las 'das nas bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du shing zad me zad bzhin du 'dod pa yang yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs mtha' dang bral ba'i ngo bor bzhed do// ༈ //rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba des// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// 'jig rten mi shes gti mug rnam bral zhing*// mthar phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog ༈ /rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa'i lhan thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/// /na mo gu ru/ byang chub snying po rdul bral zhing khams su// rang byung rgyal ba yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// mtshungs med chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba// thub dbang 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa mchog de'i zhal gyi padmo (402)las// legs 'ongs thun mongs ma yin rdo rje'i gsung*// lhan thabs bzhi bcu'i rtsa ba bdud rtsi'i bcud// 'dod ldan rnam yud yid dga' dpal du sbyin// phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa gcig /theg pa grub mtha' thams cad rten 'brel yin// chos phung brgya khri bzhi stong gnyen por gsungs// re re la yang gsung rab bcu gnyis tshang*// de nyid sde snod gcig la'ang gsum ka 'dus// 'khor 'das thams cad phun tshogs lnga yis bsdus// thun mong thun mong ma yin mngon pa'i sde// mu stegs bon gyis bden pa mthong skabs med// thar pa cha mthun 'ga' zhig yod kyang rung*// sdom dang snying rje phyi rol pa la'ang yod// mtshan nyid theg pa tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya// chos dang nyams len 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig

/sdom gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro// mthar thug sa tshun tshogs las ngo bos bgrod// rgyu dang ldan phyir nyan rang sangs rgyas 'gyur// smros pa bral phyir 'khor ba mtha' med bzhed// chos kun so sor thar sdom re rer 'du// sde pa kun gyi rtsa ba lung sde bzhi// rmi lam du ni nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung*// dag pa'i sa thob ngan 'gror song ba'ang yod// rgyu spyod gyur na sa bcu pa yang ltung*// nyams len rmad byung rnal 'byor nang gi tshogs// ting 'dzin mtha' dag rdo rje lta bu ste// sde snod gsum mam de yi snying po sngags// rtogs kyang brgyud pa zab phyir cho ga dgos// lha gcig gis kyang phrin las thams cad 'grub// lha kun mtshan ni lhag pa'i lha yis bzung*// dus bzhir rtsa ba'i dam tshig gnang skabs med// lha la gcig char 'jug pa zab mo'i gnad// rten 'brel tshogs las grub par shes pa dgos// tha mal lus su btags phyir dka' (403)thub smad// drang nges med par cho ga rgyas par dgos// de yis 'dul na bsdus pa yang ni bzhed// srung ba'i 'khor lo rmad byung byang chub sems// rtsa rlung gdams pa 'dul ba lhag par zab// byin mthus kun gzhi dus gzhan du yang mthong*// rtsa rlung thig le snyigs ma dug bcas zab// rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim bslab pa gsum// phar phyin drug ni thag pa gsum ga'i lam// dpon slob phan tshun dam tshig mnyam par gcig /dge ba'i ngo bos phyag chen sgrib mi srid// bral ba'i 'bras bu thams cad rgyu dang bcas// nam mkha' gnyis 'dres nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs// rlung mi 'dzin pa lhug par 'jog pa zab// rnam shes bla ma 'od gsal 'pho ba'i mchog /byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs sangs rgyas yin// de ltar gang gi dgongs pa kun gsal mtha'// dbang thob rnams kyis dpag par sla min yang*// 'dab ldan mkha' lding dbang po spyan snga ba'i// mkhyen dpyod gshog yangs rlabs kyis bgrod pa gang*// sngon byon rnams kyis gsal bar byas mod kyang*// blo dman rnams la phan phyir lhan thabs rnams// tshigs su bcad pa yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng*// dpyod ldan dga' ba'i do shal 'di bstar bas// legs byas dge ba stong phrag 'bar ba'i gzis// skye 'gro'i sgrib mun gcig car drung phyungs nas// lung dang rtogs pa'i tshogs gnyis padmo'i tshal// rgyas pa'i bcud la rol pa'i dpal thob shog

/ces pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa'i dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i lhan thabs/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di slob dpon rdzogs chen tshang sogs mos ldan rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rje bla ma dharma (404)sū ryas stsal ba'o// ༈ //dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i chings rnam bzhi bzhugs/ dri med 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du// ma 'dres shes bya'i dngos po ji ltar ba// thams cad gzigs pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje// mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba de yi zhal nas gsungs pa yis// dam chos khyad 'phags thun mongs ma yin pa// mngon du mdzad pa'i bzhed lugs dpag med kyang*// rmongs pas dran pa cung zad tsam zhig bri// de'ang*/ ༈ /chos rje rin po che rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bzhed dgongs// rdo rje'i gsung tshig brgya dang lnga bcu pa lhan thabs dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa 'di/ chings rnams pa bzhis ston pa yin gsung*/ de la dang po rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa yin tshul ji ltar ston pa dang gcig /rdo rje'i gsung ci ltar yin tshul ston pa dang gnyis/ chos kyi ngo bo ci ltar yin bya ba ston pa dang gsum/ nyams su ji ltar len tshul ston pa dang bzhi yin no// dang po dgongs pa gcig pa ci ltar yin bya ba la bzhi ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku skrun pas na yum du gcig /'di nyid la brten nas rgyal ba thams cad sangs rgyas pas gshegs shul du gcig /dper na gru gong gi mi bzhin nam ma bu bzhin du dgongs pa gcig /rgyal ba thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i ror ye shes brnyes par gcig pa dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa rdo rje'i gsung ci ltar yin bya ba la yang bzhi ste/ tha snyad mkhan po'i tshig dang rtog ges rtogs par dka' ba'i don gyis rdo rje/ dper na rdzas kyi dngos po rdo rje pha lam bzhin du gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i don gyis na rdo rje/

mi (405)phyed rdo rje bzhin du gzhan gyis mi phyed pa'i don gyis na rdo rje/ bod rgan spyi pa'i grub mtha' sna tshogs kyi nang 'dir dkon zhing rmad du byung ba'i don gyis na rdo rje dang bzhi'o// gsum pa chos kyi ngo bo ci ltar yin tshul la bzhi ste// ngo bo 'khor 'das thams cad la nam mkha' bzhin du mi khyab pa med pa dang gcig /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar du dngos po thams cad la mi stong ba med pa dang gnyis/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin du 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad dang mi ldan pa med pa dang gsum/ nyon mongs pa'i skyon thams cad kyis gos pa med pa dang bzhi'o// bzhi pa la yang bzhi ste/ bla ma dang chos nyams len ci ltar yin na/ bla ma 'jig rten mgon po yin bya ba dang gcig /chos gdams ngag phyag rgya chen po yin bya ba dang gnyis/ gang zag ni 'jig rten blos spangs pa gcig dgos bya ba dang gsum/ gnas ri khrod dang nags khrod du nyams su len pa dang bzhi'o// de ltar chos kyi gnad rtsa ba bzhi la/ re re yang bzhi bzhi bgyis pa 'di/ dgongs pa gcig pa'i chings yin zhes dpal dam chos gling ba bzhed do// de ltar na mnyam med 'bri khung pa'i/ dam pa'i chos kun dang thun mong ma yin pa dgongs pa gcig pa bya ba la/ rdo rje'i gsung rkang pa brgya lnga bcu yod/ tshoms chen po bdun yod/ khog dbubs bka' brgyud bla ma'i rnam thar brgyud pa byung khungs dang bcas pa yod/ gzhung lnga ldan yod/ nyams len sdom gsum gnad gcig yod// dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa la// lam zab mo bla ma'i mos gus yod// ngo sprod lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yod// gtan 'bebs dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yod// gtso bor stong nyid rgyu dang 'bras bu yod// gzhir bzhag snang ba rang sems yod/ (406)chos thams cad ces bya ba ni// 'khor 'das gnyis su 'dus/ 'khor 'das gnyis rang gi sems la 'dus/

sems stong pa chos skur bstan la phab pas/ don des na/ dper na gdugs kyi tshul du chos thams cad mnyam par nyid dbye ba med par khog phub/ gdugs kyi sham bu'i tshul du rgyu 'di song na 'bras bu 'di 'byung bya ba sha mong gi sul bzhin ma 'dres par so sor sham phyi/ gdugs kyi yu ba'i tshul du sdom gsum gnad gcig tu dril nas nyams su len/ gdugs kyi tog gi tshul du bla ma'i mos gus kyis bogs 'don pa'o// bstan bcos mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la skyon drug dang bral zhing yon tan gsum dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ de skad du'ang*/ theg bsdus 'grel pa las/ don med don log don dang ldan/ thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len dang*/ ngan g.yo brtse bral snying rjer ldan// zhes pas skyon drug dang bral zhing yon tan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ ༈ /khog dbubs pa dmigs/ khog dbubs kyis dmigs brgyad kyi nang nas gsum pa tshoms bdun go rim gyi rnam dbye'i skabs nas/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i 'khor lo rnam pa gnyis po dang bral dang 'dra bar 'dir yang go rim ji ltar byas nas tshoms rnam pa bdun po 'di bstan kyang 'gal ba med/ 'on kyang sdom pa gsum gyi tshoms 'di nges pa can yin gsung ba 'di la gdams ngag cung zhig sbyar na/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos 'di 'khor lo gnyis su thag gcod na/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gi 'khor lo dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba gnyis yin te/ de yang rdo rje'i gnas bdun gyi nang nas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te dang po gsum ni 'bras bu dkon mchog gi 'khor lo yin la/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i khams de nyid sad byed (407)kyi rkyen lam gyi chos rnams kyis sad par byas zhing byang chub yon tan phrin las mngon du gyur pa la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bshad do// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/

gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur ba// de nyid sbyangs pa byas pa las// dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das// chos kyi sku yang de nyid do// zhes gsungs te/ gang zhig gang du 'khor ba'i rgyu ni sems phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi bag chags thams cad kyis yongs su bsgom pa sa bon thams cad pa'i kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'o// de nyid rnam par mi tog pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu mthun pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyis rnam par sbyangs pa las/ rim gyis dag par gyur pa de nyid la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku yang de nyid yin no// zhes 'grel pa mkhan pos kyang bkral te/ de lta bu'i 'khor lo rnam pa gnyis po 'di'i 'brel kyang*/ thog mar dkon mchog gsum nas smos na 'bras bu la brod pa bskyed pa dang lam du 'jug pa'i thog mar skyabs gnas la sogs pa'i dgos ched mang po yod pas/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gi 'khor lo nas brtsams te gnas bdun rim pa ltar ro// yang na rgyu khams sbyangs pa las rkyen byang chub yon tan phrin las mngon du gyur pa la ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'khor lo ste/ 'bras bu phyis 'chad pa'i 'brel ltar gyis kyang chog ste/ dri ma med pa'i byang chub dang 'bras bu'i dkon mchog la tha dad med pa'i tshul ltar na dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang dpe de bzhin du tshoms rnam pa bdun po yang lta spyod kyi tshoms nas bslab gsum chos 'khor rten 'brel sangs rgyas kyis ste/ de ltar ston na mi gnas pa'i (408)mya ngan las 'das pa/ 'khor lo dang mtshungs yang na sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon/ des chos gsungs/ gang gsungs na bslab pa rin po che gsum/ de rten 'brel rgyu 'bras su lta spyod sgom gsum rnam dag gis nyams su len tshul la sogs pa'i 'brel gzhan gsum dang bzhi po 'di yi lugs ltar na 'bras bu dkon mchog gi 'khor lo'i tshul ltar yin no// 'di'i mtshan nyid 'khor lo rnam gnyis gsal byed du gsal lo/

༈ /yang na/ sangs rgyas las chos chos las 'phags pa'i tshogs// zhes sogs kyi 'brel dang go rim ni 'bras bu dkon mchog gi 'khor lo yin la/ yang*/ phrin las kyi sems can gyi don byas pa las kyang gzhan dag gi rgyud las sangs rgyas la sogs pa snga ma ltar 'byung zhing 'khor ba la ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'khor lo zhes kyang bya'o// yang sangs rgyas kyis chos bstan de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun thob par byed pa/ dag rgyu khams/ bdag rkyen byang chub yon tan phrin las rnams ni rim pa ltar yin/ yang kha cig 'bras bu ni byang chub yon tan phrin las la/ dag rgyu khams/ rkyen lam ston pa'i dkon mchog gsum dang 'bras bu gsum/ rgyun bzhir nges zhes pa yang rung ngo*// rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar dge ba des// rin chen bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// 'jig rten mi shes gti mug rnam bral zhing*// mthar phyin sangs rgyas ye shes thob par shog// /sarba dwa maṅga laṃ bha ba tu/// /
